description: Update Google GenAI provider utilities to properly preserve configuration fields when the config parameter is provided as a dictionary. Currently, labels, cached_content, and other fields are being discarded or incorrectly handled in dictionary-style configs, which is causing tracking issues for enterprise users.
functional_requirements: Modify the config merging logic to correctly handle labels, cached_content, automatic_function_calling, and thinking_config fields from both dictionary-style and object-style config parameters
Ensure cached_content properly suppresses system_instruction and tool definitions when active, regardless of config format
Add comprehensive test coverage to verify label preservation and cached content behavior specifically for dictionary-style config inputs
